description: Ministry of Health - Order to Impose Regulations by the Minister of Health for the Medical Devices, Priceing and Refail Price (MRP) Stipulated
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing pricing controls and requirements for medical devices. It creates new regulatory requirements and compliance obligations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure classifications.
